5afa5d327d944e29:es.source:
Options: `--seed <n>` (default 71), `--port <n>` (default 47820, or `0` for ephemeral),
`--shock <district:metric:delta@round>` or `--no-shock`, `--engine <dir>`,
`--forge <dir>`, `--unresolved-ai-profile <fail|warn>` (default `fail`;
`--release` selects `warn` and forwards `--sidecar-stderr=<log>` to Godot),
`--godot <bin>` (Godot executable path, default `GODOT_BIN` or `godot`),
`--headless` (start the sim only, print the port, and wait),
`--stage-headless` (launch Godot with `--headless` and closed stdin alongside
the sim), and `--quit-after-sync <path>` (pass `--quit-after-sync=<path>` to
Godot so `Playable` writes a JSON sync summary after attach and baseline
snapshot, detaches, and exits `0`). Notice a release-exported Godot stage never spawns the sim directly (it only attaches via `--attach`):
`fail` vs `warn` comes from `tools/play.mjs` (`--release`), `tools/sidecar_harness.gd`
(`OS.is_debug_build()`), or CI's explicit `--unresolved-ai-profile fail`.

bed9701593e11846:es.source:
**Errors.** Transport faults, refused connections, handshake version mismatches,
staleness, and halted sync caps are reported as plain sentences on the status
line and in the log (`[stale] state drift at tick N: expected X, mirror Y, first
differing pre-image offset K (resync 1/3)`), never as raw exceptions in the UI.
Godot's own `--verbose` flag turns on engine-level logging; nothing the stage
logs contains a secret because it never holds one.
bed9701593e11846:es.translation:
**Errores.** Los fallos de transporte, las conexiones rechazadas, las discrepancias en la versión del protocolo de enlace, la antigüedad y los límites de sincronización interrumpidos se informan como frases sencillas en la línea de estado y en el registro (`[stale] state drift at tick N: expected X, mirror Y, first
differing pre-image offset K (resync 1/3)`), nunca como excepciones sin procesar en la interfaz de usuario. La bandera `--verbose` de Godot activa el registro a nivel de motor; nada de lo que registra la etapa contiene un secreto porque nunca lo almacena.

differing pre-image offset K (resync 1/3)`), nunca como exceções brutas na interface do usuário.
O próprio `--verbose` do Godot ativa o registro em nível de motor; nada que o estágio
registra contém um segredo porque ele nunca o possui.

bed9701593e11846:zh.source:
**Errors.** Transport faults, refused connections, handshake version mismatches,
staleness, and halted sync caps are reported as plain sentences on the status
line and in the log (`[stale] state drift at tick N: expected X, mirror Y, first
differing pre-image offset K (resync 1/3)`), never as raw exceptions in the UI.
Godot's own `--verbose` flag turns on engine-level logging; nothing the stage
logs contains a secret because it never holds one.
bed9701593e11846:zh.translation:
**错误。** 传输故障、拒绝的连接、握手版本不匹配、过时和停止的同步都会报告为状态行和日志中的纯文本句子（`[stale] state drift at tick N: expected X, mirror Y, first
differing pre-image offset K (resync 1/3)`），而不是 UI 中的原始异常。Godot 自己的 `--verbose` 标志会启用引擎级别的日志记录；该阶段记录的任何内容都不包含任何秘密，因为它从不持有任何秘密。

f630cbabd51ff818:fr.source:
**CI triggers and path filters.** GitHub Actions gates runs on watched project
paths (`project.godot`, `client/**`, `stage/**`, `tools/**`, `tests/**`,
`fixtures/**`, `entities/**`, `transitions/**`, `assets/**`, `.github/workflows/**`,
`.github/upstream-pins.env`, `atlas/**`) and skips `pull_request` jobs from
same-repository branches because the matching `push` run tests that commit.
Because `on.push.paths` inspects only the pushed range (`before..after`) while
`on.pull_request.paths` inspects the whole PR diff (`base...head`), a same-repo
PR with earlier watched commits leaves its tip SHA without a `headless` run
after either (1) an unwatched-only follow-up commit (`README.md`,
`CHANGELOG.md`, `site/**`, docs) or (2) a commit-message-only or unwatched-only
`--amend` force-push — the watched edits already ran on push, run again on
merge to `main` (`main^..main`), or can be run via `workflow_dispatch`. On
`main`, job concurrency keeps one running job plus at most one pending job
(`cancel-in-progress: false`), so two quick merges both run while a third merge
before the first finishes supersedes the queued second whose tree it includes.
f630cbabd51ff818:fr.translation:
**Déclencheurs CI et filtres de chemin.** GitHub Actions filtre (conditionne) les exécutions selon les chemins de projet surveillés (`project.godot`, `client/**`, `stage/**`, `tools/**`, `tests/**`, `fixtures/**`, `entities/**`, `transitions/**`, `assets/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, `.github/upstream-pins.env`, `atlas/**`) et ignore `pull_request` tâches provenant des branches du même dépôt, car l’exécution `push` correspondante teste ce commit.
Étant donné que `on.push.paths` n’examine que la plage envoyée (`before..after`), tandis que `on.pull_request.paths` examine l’ensemble des différences de la demande de fusion (`base...head`), une demande de fusion du même dépôt avec des commits surveillés antérieurs laisse son dernier SHA sans exécution `headless` après soit (1) un commit de suivi ne modifiant que des fichiers non surveillés (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `site/**`, docs), soit (2) une poussée forcée `--amend` ne modifiant que le message de commit ou que des fichiers non surveillés. Les modifications surveillées ont déjà été exécutées lors de la poussée, elles sont exécutées à nouveau lors de la fusion vers `main` (`main^..main`), ou peuvent être exécutées via `workflow_dispatch`. Sur `main`, la concurrence des tâches maintient une tâche en cours d’exécution et au maximum une tâche en attente (`cancel-in-progress: false`), de sorte que deux fusions rapides s’exécutent toutes les deux, tandis qu’une troisième fusion avant la fin de la première remplace la deuxième tâche en attente, dont elle inclut l’arborescence.

f630cbabd51ff818:pt.translation:
**Gatilhos de CI e filtros de caminho.** O GitHub Actions restringe as execuções aos caminhos de projeto monitorados (`project.godot`, `client/**`, `stage/**`, `tools/**`, `tests/**`, `fixtures/**`, `entities/**`, `transitions/**`, `assets/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, `.github/upstream-pins.env`, `atlas/**`) e ignoram `pull_request` tarefas de ramos do mesmo repositório porque a execução de `push` correspondente testa esse commit.
Como `on.push.paths` inspeciona apenas o intervalo enviado (`before..after`), enquanto `on.pull_request.paths` inspeciona toda a diferença do PR (`base...head`), um PR do mesmo repositório com commits monitorados anteriores deixa seu SHA no final sem uma execução `headless` após (1) um commit de acompanhamento contendo apenas arquivos não monitorados (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `site/**`, docs) ou (2) um envio forçado `--amend` que contém apenas a mensagem do commit ou que não foi monitorado — as edições monitoradas já foram executadas no envio, são executadas novamente na mesclagem para `main` (`main^..main`) ou podem ser executadas por meio de `workflow_dispatch`. Em `main`, a concorrência de tarefas mantém uma tarefa em execução mais, no máximo, uma tarefa pendente (`cancel-in-progress: false`), portanto, duas mesclagens rápidas são ambas executadas, enquanto uma terceira mesclagem antes que a primeira termine substitui a segunda, que estava na fila e cujo árvore está incluída.
